notes.title: Demo #1 — Minor Update V1.2.0
notes.notes: [p][b]Gameplay:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed ledge snap getting triggered when not needed, which now results in a much more fluid movement feeling during platforming. It should now be triggered when its actually needed to reach a platform / ledge[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wall collider to prevent wall jumps on it that leads to exiting level bounds in flower platform section of the demo[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Graphics:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved performance by implementing a multi-threaded graphics render commands pipeline that reduces CPU load on the main thread[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented ability to change display resolution in addition to upscaling options (DLSS, FSR, and STP)[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to set maximum FPS to limit FPS to a custom choice (can be useful to preserve battery life on a notebook)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved graphics performance by reducing graphics memory usage of several GB without a loss of visual fidelity [/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added loading spinner for warm up screen to indicate the game is working on compiling the shaders[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added UI volume slider to adjust user interface (UI) related audio loudness[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded audio volume sliders to go to 150% loudness from previous maximum 100% to allow for more personalized options as well as improving accessibility for users that require it[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo #1 — Minor Update V1.1.0
notes.notes: [p][b]Graphics:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed majority of DX12 shader stutter by introducing a shader compilation step when the game is started. Not all shaders can be pre warmed as of now due to a limitation by the used game engine (Unity)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Corrected gamepad prompt icons for Nintendo Switch Pro Controller to be shown correctly for gameplay prompts[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo #1 — Minor Update V1.0.1
notes.notes: [p][b]Gameplay:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Checkpoints restore all of player's life[/p][/*][*][p]Added wall jump blocker to level segment (first key pick-up area) to limit wall jumps that visuals match with level boundaries[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Graphics:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Implemented a check if the game is running on a Steam Deck and uses new recommended default values that enables FSR2 upscaling by default[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Depth of Field (DoF) effect in the foreground of the player and it is only used in the background now[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance by optimizing water rendering settings[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Unity STP upscaler to have the same rendering injection point as DLSS and FSR to ensure same upscaling behavior[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed start buttons not being tinted and thus indicating focus is set on them for the game start screen as well as demo start screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added slope slide down controls hint to make sure players know how to accelerate and slow down while on slopes[/p][/*][*][p]Speed up of dialog text characters appearing in dialogs with NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Preparations for control rebindings functionality by introducing a new controls sub tab menu UI setup[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed SFX volume slider in audio settings having no effect and it now correctly lowers sound effects loudness[/p][/*][/list]
